# InNetwork_Neuromorphic_Processing

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Embedding neuromorphic computation directly within network switches or routers to perform in-situ neural inference and learning. Reduces data movement and latency, making distributed neuromorphic systems viable for real-time, high-throughput applications.
